theorem lg_target (x y : ℝ) (h₁ : x + y = 10) (h₂ : x - y = 4) : x * y = 21 := by
  have x_eq : x = 7 := by
    rw [h₁, h₂]
    erw [add_right_inj, sub_right_inj]
    simp [add, sub]
  have y_eq : y = 3 := by
    rw [h₁, h₂]
    erw [add_right_inj, sub_right_inj]
    simp [add, sub]
  rw [x_eq, y_eq]
  simp [mul]
